analysis: The code snippet defines a method parsePropertyName that uses a StringTokenizer to split a property name by dots. The while loop condition tokenizer.hasMoreTokens() is checked before each call to nextToken(). According to the StringTokenizer documentation, nextToken() throws NoSuchElementException if there are no more tokens. However, due to the loop guard, nextToken() is only called when hasMoreTokens() returns true, so the condition that would cause the exception (no more tokens) is avoided. Therefore, NoSuchElementException is fully avoided in this context.
remark: The NoSuchElementException is not triggered because the while loop ensures tokenizer.hasMoreTokens() is true before each call to nextToken(), preventing the scenario where no tokens remain.
